article.title: Why Product Labels Can Mislead Shoppers

paragraphs.en: A label can be truthful and still create a misleading impression. Pictures, colors, and large words often attract attention before shoppers read the details. A package showing fresh fruit may contain little fruit, while a product advertised as natural may still be high in sugar. These examples show why consumers should compare the overall message with the ingredient list. The question is not only whether a statement is technically accurate, but also whether the presentation helps people make a fair comparison. Clear information should reveal meaningful differences rather than hide them behind attractive design.
paragraphs.zh: 標示可能真實，卻仍造成誤導印象。圖片、顏色與大字通常在消費者閱讀細節前吸引注意。畫著新鮮水果的包裝可能果汁很少；標榜天然的商品仍可能含糖很高。因此消費者應比較整體訊息與成分表。問題不只是聲明技術上是否正確，還包括呈現方式是否有助公平比較。清楚資訊應揭露真正差異，而非用設計掩蓋。
paragraphs.ja: ラベルの内容が事実でも、誤解を招く印象を与えることがある。写真や色、大きな文字は詳細より先に目に入る。果物の写真があっても果汁が少ない商品や、「自然」と書かれていても糖分が多い商品がある。表示全体と原材料を比べることが重要だ。
